facts.text: The upstream program controls the Lake Shore 332 temperature controller and its PID loop
The upstream programs reach the instruments through PyVISA and NI-VISA
The Lake Shore is opened as the VISA resource GPIB0::12::INSTR
The control-loop temperature is read with KRDG? and the Celsius reading with CRDG?
The heater range is read with RANGE? and the heater output with HTR?
Setpoint 1 is read with SETP? 1
The setpoint entry is labelled with kelvin
Setpoint 1 is written as SETP 1,<value>
Loop 1 PID is read with PID? 1

Loop 1 PID is written as PID 1,

,,
Manual output 1 is read with MOUT? 1
Manual output is written as MOUT 1,<value>
The heater range is written as RANGE <index>
Heater range 0 is Off; ranges 1, 2 and 3 are low (0.5 W), medium (5 W) and high (50 W)
The setpoint entry is labelled 4.5 to 280
The P and I entries are labelled 0.1 to 1000
The D entry is labelled 0 to 200
The manual output entry is labelled 0.0 to 100.0
The manual output is displayed in percent
The controller temperature is displayed in kelvin and the Celsius reading with a degree-Celsius suffix
The heater output is displayed in percent
Importing the upstream file builds the Tk window, so this package does not import it
